purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry access review.
assessment: Comune di Genova officially publishes Geoservizi WMS/WFS at https://mappe.comune.genova.it/geoserver/ows. An anonymous WFS 2.0 GetCapabilities request returned HTTP 200; cadastral-named entries exposed by that public service are historical cartographic layers (e.g. 1656, 1414, 1810, 1907), not a current parcel-feature layer. The official Geoportale guide marks Particelle catastali as reserved access. The national cadastral dataset listing for Comune di Genova advertises WMS/WFS, but the published municipal portal identifies that modern parcel layer as reserved; no GetFeature request was made against it. No public safe current-parcel geometry response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Official Genova sources identify a cadastral parcel map layer in the city geoportal, explicitly mark it reserved, and publish local cadastral-map metadata. This establishes a local cadastral source, not anonymous public geometry access.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Municipal page documents WMS/WFS endpoints; WFS returns feature data and use is tied to competence/planning tasks.
Official Geoportale guide labels the current Particelle catastali map layer restricted-access.
European data portal lists the Comune di Genova cadastral dataset and WMS/WFS distributions, updated 2025-01-27; does not itself establish public feature access.
Anonymous capabilities metadata returned historical CATASTO layers; no current public parcel feature type identified.
